summary: CRT locale-info retrieval with two modes selected by a1. Mode 1 (string) fetches an LCTYPE string via sub_597E4F into a 128-byte stack buffer, growing to a heap buffer when GetLastError() == 122, then allocates a result buffer and copies the data with sub_587DD0; all heap temporaries are freed with sub_58AA6F. Mode 0 (numeric) reads 4 bytes of raw locale data via sub_597D3C into the global LCData buffer and accumulates digits into *(BYTE*)a4, breaking on the first non-numeric byte (classification via off_5E69C8 when cbMultiByte <= 1, else CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback). Returns 0 on success and -1 on query, allocation, or mode failure.

local_names.a1: mode selector: 1 = string retrieval, 0 = numeric parse, anything else returns -1
local_names.a4: out pointer: receives the allocated string pointer (mode 1) or the accumulated numeric byte (mode 0)
local_names.LCData: 128-byte stack buffer for the first string fetch
local_names.v4: active source buffer for the copy (stack LCData or the heap temp)
local_names.v5: byte count returned by the locale fetch
local_names.v6: required buffer size from the size-query call
local_names.v7: alias of v6 used as the fetch length
local_names.v11: iterator over the global LCData bytes in numeric mode
local_names.v15: flag: 1 when the temporary buffer is heap-allocated and must be freed

operations.description: Mode dispatch: a1 == 1 selects string retrieval, a1 == 0 selects numeric parsing, and any other a1 returns -1
sub_597E4F(Locale, LCType, LCData, 128, 0) fetches the locale string into the 128-byte stack buffer
On an empty first fetch, GetLastError() must be 122 (ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER) to continue with the size query; otherwise return -1
sub_597E4F(Locale, LCType, 0, 0, 0) queries the required buffer size
MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(v6) allocates the required temporary heap buffer; failure returns -1
v15 is set to 1 to flag the temporary buffer as heap-allocated (must be freed on cleanup)
sub_597E4F(Locale, LCType, v8, v7, 0) fetches the locale string into the heap temporary
MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(v5) allocates the result buffer and *a4 is set to it; a null result triggers error cleanup
sub_587DD0(v9, v4, v5) copies the locale string from the source buffer to the result buffer
sub_58AA6F(v4) frees the heap-allocated temporary buffer when v15 is set
A failed fetch or null result buffer after the size query jumps to the shared error cleanup (sub_58AA6F(v4) + return -1)
sub_597D3C(Locale, LCType, &LCData, 4, 0) reads 4 bytes of raw locale data into the global LCData buffer; a null result returns -1
*(_BYTE *)a4 = 0 initializes the numeric accumulator before the parse loop
Iterates over the LCData bytes from the global buffer start up to the word_8D41CC bound, accumulating one digit per iteration

Character classification: when cbMultiByte <= 1 the table lookup off_5E69C8[0][v12] & 4 is used, otherwise CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback(v12, 4); a non-numeric class result breaks the loop
*(_BYTE *)a4 = v12 + 10 * *(_BYTE *)a4 - 48 accumulates each decimal digit into the result byte
Returns 0 on success, -1 on locale query failure, allocation failure, or an invalid mode
Invoked by sub_58F014, AudioCodecBufferAllocation, sub_58F7C9 and sub_58F939

unresolved: The exact semantics of mode-0 digit parsing (leading zeros, sign handling, and the terminating condition at word_8D41CC) are inferred from the loop shape
The cbMultiByte / off_5E69C8 relationship is a character-classification table with a version switch; the exact table layout is unknown
The a4 output contract differs per mode (allocated string pointer vs byte accumulator); the caller expectations are not documented
